effect.guhs.stil.uitleg: You make no sound at all: knabbel sensors don't hear you walk, eat or dig, and the Vadswaker can neither hear nor sniff you. Shh... even your tummy rumbles in a whisper.
effect.guhs.onvahoeg.uitleg: You feel a little less vahoeg for a while: you walk 12% slower and get hungry faster. Never dangerous, just a bit sad.
effect.guhs.gezellig.uitleg: Every 4 seconds you heal a little (half a heart, more when it is stronger) and pink hearts float around you. Tea with guhs, njeg!
effect.guhs.uitgerust.uitleg: You walk 10% faster, and when you are hurt you heal half a heart every 5 seconds. A well-rested guh does its chores 15% faster. VAHOEG well slept!
effect.guhs.blosjes.uitleg: Little hearts float around you, and now and then you heal half a heart. An ice cream just makes you blush.
effect.guhs.zweverig.uitleg: Gravity is 60% lower: you jump higher and float gently down, and a fall only hurts after 16 extra blocks. Like an ice-cream cloud!
effect.guhs.besties.uitleg: Every 2.5 seconds you heal a little (half a heart, more when it is stronger) and now and then a heart appears. Best friends, just like Schilly and its guh.
effect.guhs.fris_van_binnen.uitleg: You walk 25% faster and sparkle now and then. Poepschilly did a fine scrubbing job!
effect.guhs.lief_kijken.uitleg: Guhs within 8 blocks make hearts, and a kaasknabbel gets an extra chance to tame a wild guh right away. Taming muisjes is easier, and Poepschilly and guhxolotls let themselves be tamed at once. Who can resist that little face?
effect.guhs.sausdieren_stuiter.uitleg: Falling doesn't hurt, and when you fall more than a block and a half you bounce back up. Boing, vads!
effect.guhs.torenpeper_peperadem.uitleg: A tiny flame comes out with every breath, and you can't freeze. It sets nothing on fire, promise.
effect.guhs.hik.uitleg: About every second and a half a hiccup: a little hop and a squeaky 'hic!'. Completely harmless, just a bit silly.
effect.guhs.fris_en_blij.uitleg: Every few seconds a heart and now and then a happy little dance. Nothing more: just fresh and happy after a bubble bath!
effect.guhs.bubbelig.uitleg: You jump a bit higher, you land a bit softer (2 extra blocks without fall damage) and little bubbles pop around you. Harmless and very bubbly.
effect.guhs.uitleg.onbekend: A guh effect. What it does exactly? The guh keeps that secret for now, njeg!
effect.minecraft.mining_fatigue.uitleg: You mine and attack much slower.
effect.minecraft.strength.uitleg: You hit harder (+3 damage per level).
effect.minecraft.jump_boost.uitleg: You jump higher and land softer.
effect.minecraft.resistance.uitleg: You take less damage (20% per level).
effect.minecraft.fire_resistance.uitleg: Fire and lava don't hurt you.
effect.minecraft.invisibility.uitleg: You are invisible, but your armour and items are not.
effect.minecraft.blindness.uitleg: You can barely see and can't sprint.
effect.minecraft.night_vision.uitleg: You see everything in the dark.
effect.minecraft.weakness.uitleg: You hit softer (-4 damage per level).
effect.minecraft.poison.uitleg: You slowly lose health, but it won't kill you.
effect.minecraft.wither.uitleg: You slowly lose health, and this one can kill you.
effect.minecraft.health_boost.uitleg: You get extra hearts (2 per level).
effect.minecraft.absorption.uitleg: Golden extra hearts that take the damage first.
effect.minecraft.saturation.uitleg: Your hunger is filled up at once.
effect.minecraft.glowing.uitleg: You have a glowing outline everyone sees through walls.
effect.minecraft.luck.uitleg: A bit more chance on good loot from chests and fishing.
effect.minecraft.unluck.uitleg: A bit less chance on good loot.
effect.minecraft.slow_falling.uitleg: You fall very slowly and take no fall damage.
effect.minecraft.conduit_power.uitleg: Under water you can breathe, see better and mine faster.
effect.minecraft.bad_omen.uitleg: A bad omen: walk into a village or a trial chamber with it and things get exciting.
effect.minecraft.hero_of_the_village.uit: Villagers give you discounts and gifts.
effect.minecraft.darkness.uitleg: Now and then it gets very dark around you.
effect.minecraft.trial_omen.uitleg: Trial spawners get tougher: stronger enemies, better loot.
effect.minecraft.raid_omen.uitleg: A raid on this village starts any moment now.
effect.minecraft.wind_charged.uitleg: When you die, a gust of wind bursts out of you.
effect.minecraft.weaving.uitleg: When you die, you spin cobwebs around you.
effect.minecraft.oozing.uitleg: When you die, little slimes come out of you.
effect.minecraft.infested.uitleg: When you are hurt, silverfish may crawl out of you.
Under water you don't run out of breath.
